claims.text: Switchy provides customizable, manageable and trackable retargeting links to boost conversions

quote.text: Switchy.io lets you customize, manage, and track retargeting links so you can boost conversions.

claims.text: Users can customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks

quote.text: You have the ability to customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks.

claims.text: Users can edit title, domain, description and image for links

quote.text: Edit the title, domain, description, and image so your links shine.

claims.text: Links support retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect, A/B testing and deep links via 30+ advanced options

quote.text: From there, you can add retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect, A/B testing, or even activate deep links using 30+ advanced options to help your conversions skyrocket.

claims.text: Retargeting pixels can be integrated into links without technical skills with step-by-step instructions

quote.text: You can integrate retargeting pixels directly into your links without any technical skills thanks to step-by-step instructions.

claims.text: Every user who clicks a link will be automatically pixeled and targeted on any ads platform

quote.text: So now every user who clicks your link will be automatically pixeled and targeted on any Ads Platform.

claims.text: Smart deep links from 150+ integrated platforms can steer audience to specific pages per platform or device

quote.text: Plus, you can drive your users to the highest-converting channels with smart deep links from +150 integrated platforms, letting you steer your audience to specific pages on every platform or device.

claims.text: Smartpage builder offers over 100 templates and 20 block types

quote.text: The easy-to-use smartpage builder offers over 100 templates and 20 different block types to fit with any type of industry, whether you’re a DJ, social media marketer, or online retailer.

claims.text: Dashboard provides detailed metrics and analytics for each link including clicks, devices, referrals and sources

quote.text: Dive deep with detailed metrics and analytics for each link, like click numbers, device types, referrals, audience sources, and more!

claims.text: Users can run A/B tests and smart ads for campaigns

quote.text: You’ll also be able to run A/B tests and smart ads for more efficient campaigns!

trials.claim: 1 Code tier includes lifetime access with future plan updates and 60-day redemption
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Switchy
- All future plan updates
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- Stack up to 5 codes
- GDPR compliant
trials.reasoning: E1 only speculates that an account was possibly deleted, and E2 is a subjective impression about development pace; neither directly proves lifetime access, future updates, or the 60-day redemption term was not honored.

exhibits.quote: It's also possible that my account was deleted and I cannot use my codes again. $78 down the drain.
exhibits.argument: Account deletion directly contradicts lifetime access promise for redeemed codes.

exhibits.quote: The product feels more maintained than actively developed.
exhibits.argument: Undermines claim of all future plan updates by indicating no active development.

trials.claim: 1 Code tier costs $39 versus $2400 regular price
trials.claimQuote:
### 1 Code: $39 (was $2400)
- Lifetime access to Switchy
- All future plan updates
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- Stack up to 5 codes
trials.reasoning: E3 shows a different regular subscription tier at $1399 per month, which does not establish what the 1 Code tier's regular price was or that deal buyers were charged that price.

exhibits.quote: Company 1399 $ / MO. **Up to 3500000** clicks Unlimited Links Unlimited Pixels 125 Custom domain name
exhibits.argument: Highest listed regular price is $1399/mo for 3.5M clicks, making $2400 regular price for 30k tier misleading.

trials.claim: Switchy provides customizable, manageable and trackable retargeting links to boost conversions
trials.claimQuote: Switchy.io lets you customize, manage, and track retargeting links so you can boost conversions.
trials.reasoning: E7 directly states Switchy can shorten, customize, and track links with A/B testing and retargeting pixels; E4 says tracking lacks depth but confirms clicks and user metrics exist, so it does not materially undercut the claim.

exhibits.quote: There are notable gaps in the data provided. While the platform offers surface-level metrics such as clicks and user counts, it lacks depth
exhibits.argument: Contradicts trackable retargeting claim by showing tracking lacks depth needed for conversions.

exhibits.quote: Shorten, customize and track your links with A/B testing, retargeting pixels, etc.
exhibits.argument: Quote directly states Switchy lets users customize, manage and track retargeting links.

trials.claim: Users can customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks
trials.claimQuote: You have the ability to customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks.
trials.reasoning: User reports materially limit the broad social-network claim: E5 says images could only be made in a Facebook-suitable format, and E6 reports it did not work on WhatsApp.

exhibits.quote: I could only create images in a format suitable for Facebook only (horizontal rectangle).
exhibits.argument: Shows customization is limited to Facebook format, contradicting general social network customization claim.

exhibits.quote: Honestamente no me sirvió en WhatsApp y no me dieron soporte por correo electrónico.
exhibits.argument: Reports customized appearance failed to work on WhatsApp, undermining social customization promise.

exhibits.quote: With Switchy, you can customize in two clicks the appearance of a shared post on a social network. Edit the title, the description and the picture, make your links shine again and boost your CTR!
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms users can customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks.
